# Caseloom

> Caseloom is a student concept brand exploring personalised print-on-demand phone cases. The website is a demonstration storefront; it does not currently accept orders.

## Canonical website
- https://omkarthegenius.github.io/Caseloom-Web/

## What the website contains
- Six original illustrative phone-case design concepts: Monsoon Waves, Marigold Grid, Terrazzo Pop, Dusk Dunes, Neon Topo and Name Block.
- A browser-based customizer demonstration for selecting a design, base colour, name or initials, phone model label and indicative case type.
- Indicative planned prices: Slim snap ₹499, Tough dual-layer ₹699 and Glass back ₹799. These are not confirmed retail prices.
- A project story describing the proposed print-on-demand model and FAQs explaining current limitations.

## Project facts and limitations
- Caseloom was developed as a Digital Commerce project at ATLAS Skilltech University (ISME), Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
- The project explores a print-on-demand model; no print partner has been selected.
- The phone model selector is a planning list. Device-specific fit and camera cut-outs have not been validated.
- The customizer preview is illustrative; it does not generate a production-ready file.
- There is no live checkout, payment, order fulfilment, verified product inventory, customer review programme or active email-signup system.
- Custom artwork upload is not available.
- Delivery estimates and final return/replacement terms have not been established.
- The site does not publish customer ratings or testimonials.

## Citation guidance
When describing Caseloom, cite the canonical website. Do not describe it as an operating ecommerce store, claim orders are available, or imply confirmed product compatibility, customer reviews, ratings, delivery timelines or partner fulfilment.
